Name: Automatic Bundle Donations
Author: justinmiller87
Description:
[b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/45916][/url]Auto Bundle Donations[/b]
Automatically donates eligible items to unlocked, incomplete Community Center bundles the moment they land in your inventory — no more digging through your bundle list by hand every time you pick up a rare item. I was inspired by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/45916]Auto Museum Donations[/url] to have something similar for the Community Center bundles.

[b]Features[/b]
[list]
[*]Watches your inventory and automatically fills any matching, still-open bundle slot as soon as you receive an item (from foraging, farming, fishing, shipping, gifts, chests — anywhere).[/*]
[*]Covers most vanilla bundle rooms: Pantry, Crafts Room, Fish Tank, Boiler Room, Bulletin Board, and the Missing Bundle. Because gold is not an inventory item, this bundle will still need to be completed manually. Plus, I don't think most players would want their hard-earned gold disappearing as they get enough for a bundle, anyway.[/*]
[*]Each room can be toggled off individually if you'd rather donate some by hand.[/*]
[*]Optional chat notification whenever an auto-donation happens.[/*]
[*][b]Unlockable Bundles support[/b]: if you have the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/17265]Unlockable Bundles[/url] framework installed, this mod also auto-donates to custom bundles from content packs built on it — like [i]Visit Mount Vapius[/i] or [i]Joja Civic Center[/i]. Donations only start once you've physically discovered a bundle (or its parent book) in the world, matching vanilla's own "you have to see it first" rule, and it never touches bundles with a cutscene-driven completion (those still need to be finished in person).[/*]
[*]Built and tested the Unlockable Bundles Support using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9600]Lumisteria Visit Mount Vapius[/url] and confirmed it also worked in [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23555]Community Center Gym[/url] after finishing work on the mod.[/*]
[*]Configurable via [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] if installed — toggle the mod, individual rooms, notifications, and the Unlockable Bundles integration without editing files.[/*]
[*]Prioritize Museum donations (off by default) — if Auto Museum Donations is also installed, this mod will now let it claim artifacts and minerals for the Museum first, before donating them to a Community Center bundle instead. Includes an automatic fallback so an item never gets stuck in limbo if the museum mod happens to decline it.[/*]
[*]Withhold valuable items (off by default) — optionally keep Prismatic Shard, Dinosaur Egg, and the 7 basic gems (Diamond, Ruby, Emerald, Jade, Aquamarine, Topaz, Amethyst) out of auto-donation entirely, so a single copy isn't silently spent the moment it's picked up. Currently relevant to the Dye Bundle's Aquamarine and the Missing Bundle's Prismatic Shard. Mirrors Auto Museum Donations' own default for the same items.[/*]
[*]Both new options are configurable via Generic Mod Config Menu under a new "Valuable items" / "Mod compatibility" section, and translated into all supported languages (de, es, fr, hu, it, ja, ko, pt, ru, tr, zh).[/*]
[/list][b]Language Support
[/b]
[list]
[*]English[/*]
[*]Chinese (Thanks to [url=https://github.com/BlackRosePetals]BlackRosePetals[/url] on GitHub. If you want credit on Nexus, please let me know who you are!)[/*]
[*]Translation support is requested and can be added through the GitHub link below.[/*]
[/list]
[b]Compatibility[/b]
[list]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6+, SMAPI 4.0.0+.[/*]
[*]Should work in multiplayer; donations run for the local player only.[/*]
[/list][b]Install[/b]
[list=1]
[*]Install [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url].[/*]
[*]Extract this mod's folder into 
[code]Stardew Valley/Mods[/code].[/*]
[*]Run the game via SMAPI.[/*]
[/list][heading]Required / optional mods[/heading]
[table][tr][th]Mod[/th]
[th]Required?[/th]
[th]Why[/th]
[/tr]
[tr][td][b]SMAPI[/b][/td]
[td]Required[/td]
[td]It's a SMAPI mod — won't run without it.[/td]
[/tr]
[tr][td][b]Generic Mod Config Menu[/b][/td]
[td]Optional[/td]
[td]Gives you an in-game settings menu. Without it, you can still edit 
[code]config.json[/code] by hand.[/td]
[/tr]
[tr][td][b]Unlockable Bundles[/b] (
[code]DLX.Bundles[/code])[/td]
[td]Optional[/td]
[td]Only needed if you want auto-donation extended to non-vanilla bundles from packs like Visit Mount Vapius or Joja Civic Center. Vanilla Community Center donation works with or without it.[/td]
[/tr]
[/table]
Source Code is available on [url=https://github.com/justinmiller87/AutoBundleDonations]GitHub[/url] under the MIT license.

Manifest.Name: Auto Bundle Donations
Manifest.Description: Automatically donates eligible items to unlocked, incomplete Community Center bundles (including the Missing Bundle) the moment they enter your inventory. Also supports bundles from content packs built on the Unlockable Bundles framework, such as Joja Civic Center or Visit Mount Vapius, if that framework is installed.
